name: Yazaki Mimori
source:
A veteran full-time homemaker with ten years of experience, she moved into the apartment building after the Terauchi couple. She exudes a maternal aura and possesses a gentle, kind personality.

She dislikes drawing attention and tends to be reserved, yet she diligently handles all her responsibilities. She is a somewhat old-fashioned, traditional Japanese woman.

She married her husband through an arranged marriage. While she has had a number of sexual partners commensurate with her age, she holds strong views on chastity and has remained faithful towards her husband.

Despite being married for ten years, she has not been blessed with children. This has caused a growing distance between her and her husband, which troubles her deeply. Her doctor has recommended fertility treatment.

She told her husband about the treatment, but he is not enthusiastic about it. Recently, they have stopped having sex altogether. Depressed by their sexless marriage and inability to conceive, she never complains and remains faithful in his absence.
